scripts.lint: oxlint apps shared benchmark scripts --ignore-pattern benchmark/fixtures/**
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @experiment/compiler typecheck && yarn workspace @experiment/manual typecheck && yarn workspace @experiment/baseline typecheck
scripts.build: yarn workspace @experiment/compiler build && yarn workspace @experiment/manual build && yarn workspace @experiment/baseline build
scripts.build:pages: PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/compiler/ yarn workspace @experiment/compiler build && PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/manual/ yarn workspace @experiment/manual build && PAGES_BASE=/compiler-experiment/baseline/ yarn workspace @experiment/baseline build && node scripts/assemble-pages.mjs
scripts.build:profile: yarn workspace @experiment/compiler build:profile && yarn workspace @experiment/manual build:profile && yarn workspace @experiment/baseline build:profile
scripts.benchmark: yarn fmt:check && yarn lint && node scripts/check-guard.mjs && yarn typecheck && yarn build && node scripts/check-transform.mjs && yarn build:profile && playwright test && node scripts/report.mjs && node --test scripts/report.test.mjs
scripts.analyze:compiler: react-compiler-analyzer analyze apps/compiler/src shared benchmark/recorder.tsx --format json
